name: The three caves
summary: Board at Đình Các and ride sông Ngô Đồng through hang Cả, hang Hai, and hang Ba, then back to the same pier. Vietnamese Wikipedia prints about 2 hours. The ticket table prints no duration. Skip it if you wanted the Tràng An boat on sông Sào Khê.
fee: 250,000 đồng for an adult without the shuttle
getThere: From Đình Các, in thôn Văn Lâm
bestMonths: Ripe-rice days at the end of May
heroCaption: One sampan at the bright cave mouth, seen from inside the rock
gettingThere: The pier is bến thuyền Tam Cốc, at Đình Các in thôn Văn Lâm. You board there and return there. Bích Động is 2 km from the pier. Đền Thái Vi is 2 km by road, or a walk from the boat. A minute for either walk is Check on arrival. The 23 May 2023 note names bến Kẽm Gió as a step-off, with no minute. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Hà Nội
legs.body: SE7 leaves at 06:00 and reaches ga Ninh Bình at 08:16 on the railway table, or 08:13 on Asia Train Time, Vexere, and Baolau. Both stay. The station is kilometre 115. A minute from the station to the pier is Check on arrival. The river is chừng 100 km by road, and road minutes are Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From thôn Văn Lâm
legs.body: The landing is in the hamlet. Bicycles are common, and hire sits at most tourist points. A hire fee is Check on arrival. The electric shuttle is the 350,000 đồng adult ticket on the 27 February 2026 row.

admissionNote: 27 February 2026, route Tam Cốc, Đền Thái Vi, Động Tiên, and chùa Bích Động. Without the shuttle: adult 250,000 đồng, child 1–1.3 m 120,000 đồng. With the shuttle: adult 350,000 đồng, child 1–1.3 m 190,000 đồng. Hotline 19009157. A child under 1 m has no line. Check on arrival. Updated 23 May 2023: 120,000 đồng a person a turn, boat 150,000 đồng a trip for 4 domestic guests or 2 international guests, free under 3. DulichToday 2024: adult 120,000 đồng, child 60,000 đồng with no height, boat 150,000 đồng one way. All three stay. Hours are Check on arrival. Cục Di sản văn hóa prints hang Cả khoảng 180 m, hang Hai khoảng 90 m, and hang Ba hơn 80 m. Vietnamese Wikipedia prints 127 m, 60 m, and 50 m. Both sets stay. The ride ends at đền Nội Lâm on the heritage bureau note and at đền Thần Nông on Vietnamese Wikipedia. Both end-names stay.
